questions.question: What documents are needed for KYC account opening?
questions.answer:
According to the bank documents:
- Documents Needed for Account Opening
To open a personal account, the customer must provide the following documents. [KYC Policy — Know Your Customer, page 1]
- 3.4 Additional documents for special cases
A guardian opening an account for a minor must provide the minor's birth certificate and the guardian's
own identity document. [KYC Policy — Know Your Customer, page 1]
- Documents Needed for Account Opening
What documents are needed for KYC account opening? [Account Opening Policy, page 1]
- Account Opening Policy
Document: Account Opening Policy | Version: 1.0 | Department: Retail Banking | Effective: January 2026
| Review: January 2027
1. [Account Opening Policy, page 1]
- Record Keeping
All KYC documents, verification notes and risk ratings must be kept for at least ten years after the
account is closed. [KYC Policy — Know Your Customer, page 2]
- If a customer's documents expire and
are not renewed within 30 days, the account is restricted until the documents are updated. [KYC Policy — Know Your Customer, page 2]

questions.question: What is the AML reporting threshold?
questions.answer:
According to the bank documents:
- AML Reporting Threshold
The AML reporting threshold is a key rule in this policy. [Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy, page 1]
- Multiple linked cash transactions that together
total SAR 60,000 or more within 7 days must also be reported, even if each single transaction is below
the threshold. [Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy, page 1]
- Sanctions Screening
Every customer name and every payment must be checked against the sanctions lists before a
transaction is completed. [Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy, page 2]
- Any employee who
is unsure whether a transaction is suspicious should ask the Compliance Officer — asking is always
better than staying silent. [Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy, page 2]
- Compliance Calendar
The Compliance Department keeps a calendar of all SAMA reporting deadlines and inspection dates. [SAMA Compliance Summary, page 2]
- What Happens if the Bank Breaks the Rules
SAMA can warn the bank, fine the bank, restrict its activities, remove a manager, or in extreme cases
withdraw the licence. [SAMA Compliance Summary, page 2]
